title: Cleanup Prioritization
content: Inspection priority can combine AI confidence, evidence strength, location certainty and environmental risk.
A high priority recommendation does not mean that an object is confirmed hazardous.
Locations with stronger evidence and higher environmental relevance may receive higher decision-support priority.
Cleanup recommendations should remain subject to marine authority and expert review.
When evidence is insufficient, the recommendation should be expert verification rather than an unsupported cleanup action.
